text: In one of them, in the city of Handan, a boy named Zheng was born, the son of a Qin prince handed to the enemy as a hostage.
spoken: In one of them, in the city of Hahn-dahn, a boy named Jung was born, the son of a Chin prince, handed to the enemy as a hostage.
whisper: In one of them, in the city of Handan, a boy named Zhong was born, the son of a Qing prince, handed to the enemy as a hostage.
